title: Miranda Ma' "BITMAIN'S Role in Securing and Scaling a PoW Future"
description: Miranda Ma leads the BTC and LTC ecosystem initiatives at BITMAIN, where she focuses on strategic development and industry collaboration. On the Bitcoin side, she works closely with ecosystem partners to advocate for miner interests—particularly around increasing transaction fee revenue and supporting green mining and ESG efforts. For Litecoin, she is currently spearheading efforts around the potential approval of a Litecoin ETF and supporting key ecosystem initiatives such as merge mining and developer engagement through hackathons.
